span.p:
2 · AGENT DEFINITION
.claude/agents/<role>.md
stands in for AGENTS.md/SOUL.md/SKILL.md all at once,
for this one role — the citekey invariant is restated
here, inline, not read from AGENTS.md (CLAUDE.md itself
arrives anyway, so that restatement is belt-and-braces)

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

p.small:
small and specific — e.g. TOPIC/PERSPECTIVE/ROUNDS/DRAFT PATH
(interviewer), or a `dossier brief` pointer instead of pasted
evidence (writer) — see the table below for all three roles

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4 · WHAT IT RETURNS
Markdown handed back to the orchestrator
this subagent's context is discarded on return —
anything not in the returned text is gone
